name: wedding-planner-evals
description: Response-quality evals for the Your Trip planner (promptfoo). Kept apart from the site so its packages stay as they are.

scripts.eval: node build.mjs && (PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --no-cache --no-progress-bar --no-table > .results/run.log 2>&1; node report.mjs)
